first.label: stack
command: echo '=== ai-gateway stack ==='; ./scripts/docker/compose.sh ps 2>/dev/null || docker compose ps; echo; echo 'Logs: ./scripts/docker/compose.sh logs -f litellm headroom open-webui'; exec "$SHELL"

first.label: usage
command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; echo 'Token / spend CLI snapshot (LiteLLM UI is system of record: http://localhost:4000/ui/login/)'; echo; USAGE_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL=30 ./scripts/usage_snapshot.sh || true; exec "$SHELL"

second.label: trace
command: echo 'agenttrace — multi-agent session cost/health (offline logs)'; echo 'LiteLLM UI remains spend SoR: http://localhost:4000/ui/login/'; echo; if command -v agenttrace >/dev/null 2>&1; then agenttrace --version 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'Launch: agenttrace'; echo '(or keep usage pane for live gateway snapshot)'; else echo 'Install: brew install luoyuctl/tap/agenttrace'; fi; exec "$SHELL"

first.label: health
command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; echo 'LiteLLM:'; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4000/health/liveliness || true; echo; echo 'Headroom:'; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8787/readyz || true; echo; echo 'Open WebUI: http://localhost:8080  (→ Headroom → LiteLLM)'; echo 'LiteLLM UI: http://localhost:4000/ui/login/'; echo 'Hister:     http://localhost:4433  (profile search)'; echo 'Botmem:     http://localhost:12412 (profile memory)'; echo 'Grafana:    http://localhost:3000'; echo 'LM Studio:  http://localhost:1234/v1'; echo; echo 'DEFAULT (token conservation):'; echo "  OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787/v1"; echo 'BYPASS (raw LiteLLM):'; echo "  OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/v1"; echo "model=manager-fast-turbo | manager-fast-local | manager-mlx-fast"; exec "$SHELL"

first.label: agent
command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787/v1; export OPENAI_API_KEY="${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY:-}"; export OPENAI_API_BASE="$OPENAI_BASE_URL"; echo 'Agent pane — Headroom → LiteLLM (token conservation)'; echo "OPENAI_BASE_URL=$OPENAI_BASE_URL"; echo 'Bypass raw LiteLLM: export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000/v1'; echo 'Tiered orchestration: plan=role-plan | execute=role-execute | reason=role-reason | recon=role-recon | audit=role-audit | PHI=role-phi-local'; echo 'Recommended for new coding/tool sessions: role-execute'; echo 'Compatibility default remains manager-fast-turbo (same backend)'; echo 'Examples:'; echo '  pi'; echo '  tau'; echo '  ~/GitHub/turnstone/.venv/bin/turnstone --base-url http://localhost:8787/v1 --model manager-fast-turbo --api-key "$LITELLM_MASTER_KEY" --skip-permissions'; echo '  ./scripts/smoke_role_tiers.sh'; exec "$SHELL"

second.label: grok
command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; export OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787/v1; export OPENAI_API_KEY="${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY:-}"; export OPENAI_API_BASE="$OPENAI_BASE_URL"; echo 'Grok Build pane — route via Headroom→LiteLLM for spend transparency in LiteLLM UI'; echo "OPENAI_BASE_URL=$OPENAI_BASE_URL"; echo 'Direct xAI bypass will NOT appear in LiteLLM spend.'; echo; if command -v grok >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Launch: grok   (or: grok --model manager-fast-turbo)'; else echo 'grok CLI not on PATH (~/.local/bin/grok)'; fi; exec "$SHELL"
